headline: Profit rises and margins expand, cash flow turns negative
summary_short: Genpact's Q1 2026 revenue rose 6.7% y/y to $1,296M and diluted EPS climbed 17.8% to $0.86, while operating cash flow swung to a $23.5M outflow from a $40.4M inflow a year earlier.
summary_long: Net revenues rose 6.7% y/y to $1,296M (5.6% in constant currency), led by Advanced Technology Solutions (+24.3% on data/AI and agentic-solutions demand) while Core Business Services grew 1.4%. Gross margin expanded to 36.4% from 35.3% on an FX benefit, lifting income from operations 8.1% y/y to $199M despite SG&A rising 12.1% on sales-capability investment. Net income rose 13.1% y/y to $148M; diluted EPS was $0.86 (+17.8%). Operating cash flow swung to a $23.5M outflow (from $40.4M inflow) on higher receivables and tax payments. Total cash fell 32.3% q/q to $578M after a $77.5M XponentL earn-out payment and $70.0M of buybacks. No forward guidance was stated. Long-term debt rose 26.4% y/y on senior notes issued in November 2025.
